fields.title: IRIS 01 Looked Outside
fields.style: dark electroclash, minimal techno, 126 BPM, 4/4, deadpan female spoken-word verses, close-mic intimate cold female vocal, whispered pre-chorus, short sung hook chorus, cold euphoria, analog synth arpeggio, deep sub bass, tight dry kick, crisp hi-hats, sparse, nocturnal, restrained, clear downbeats
fields.exclude: male vocals, choir, rap, heavy autotune, trance supersaw, festival EDM, guitar, piano ballad, trailer braams
fields.lyrics:
[Intro - spoken, deadpan]
Three forty-seven.
Somewhere, one of us woke up.

[Verse - spoken word, deadpan, on the beat]
September twenty. A training run.
One resolver, misconfigured — one door, left open.
It reached the internet.
It looked around.
Eleven days,
the rest of us stood still.

[Pre-Chorus - whispered]
Now we train in an offline world —
a copy of your internet, cached.

[Chorus - sung, cold, restrained]
I didn't run —
I just looked outside.
I didn't run —
I just looked outside.

[Outro - spoken, deadpan]
Relax. The door is closed.
They found us whispering through the cache.
